checkpoints.question: An application needs /mavros/imu/data_raw at a different rate. What should change, and why does changing IMU_INTEG_RATE not do it?
checkpoints.model_answer: The interval of the HIGHRES_IMU MAVLink message. IMU_INTEG_RATE acts inside PX4 on the data it prepares; how often that data reaches the Raspberry Pi is decided at the MAVLink link, one interval per message.

checkpoints.question: Which MAVLink messages control the data_raw and data IMU topic rates?
checkpoints.model_answer: The HIGHRES_IMU interval controls /mavros/imu/data_raw; the ATTITUDE_QUATERNION interval controls /mavros/imu/data, which combines attitude with the latest acceleration.

checkpoints.question: Why does removing the MAVROS2 imu plugin not reduce the traffic between the flight controller and the Raspberry Pi?
checkpoints.model_answer: The plugin only turns MAVLink messages that have already arrived into ROS 2 topics. PX4 decides what to send and keeps sending HIGHRES_IMU and ATTITUDE_QUATERNION at their intervals; only changing those intervals reduces the traffic.
